title: Brussels Sprouts Shredded with Pancetta
description: Shred the brussels sprouts and cook the pancetta, reserving the drippings, 1 day ahead. Refrigerate everything separately in airtight containers.
ingredients: 1/2 pound thinly sliced pancetta, diced small
1 3/4 pounds brussels sprouts, trimmed and shredded (10 cups)
directions: In a large nonstick skillet, cook pancetta over medium, stirring occasionally, until crisp, 8 to 10 minutes. With a slotted spoon, transfer pancetta to paper towels to drain. Pour off all but 1/4 cup drippings (if necessary, add enough oil to measure 1/4 cup).
Add brussels sprouts and cook, stirring occasionally, until crisp-tender, 10 minutes. Stir in rosemary and cook until fragrant, about 2 minutes. Stir in pancetta.
Remove from heat, stir in lemon juice, and season with salt and pepper. Serve warm or at room temperature.
